assays.singlecell: droplet libraries (3', 5', multiome gene expression) sequenced on ONT, analysed with wf-single-cell
assays.visium: Visium, 55 um spots, ONT reads through wf-single-cell and/or Space Ranger
assays.visium_hd: Visium HD 3' (2 um squares), ONT reads through Space Ranger and/or wf-single-cell

aggregate_types.counts: named integer counts (a dict); mergeable by addition
aggregate_types.funnel: ordered list of {stage, reads}; each stage is a subset of the previous one
aggregate_types.hist: counts on fixed bin edges named in `bins` below; mergeable by addition
aggregate_types.rank_curve: values at log-spaced ranks (<= 200 points): {rank[], value[]}
aggregate_types.grid: 2-D map: rows, cols, layout and channels; each channel is one byte per cell, row-major, base64 (u8-b64)
aggregate_types.messages: list of {level, title, message, value, source}

log_counts_8_per_decade.description: 0, then 8 bins per decade from 1 to 1e6 (49 bins). Used for UMIs, genes and reads per barcode.

fraction_50.description: 50 linear bins from 0 to 1 (2 percentage points each). Used for mitochondrial fraction.

reads_per_molecule.description: exact counts 1..64, then one bin per power of two up to 2**20 (78 bins)

fields: plus Dorado tags carried through: fn st ch mx du ns qs pi sp er po sm sd sv dx

hdf5, CSC (matrix/data, indices, indptr, barcodes, features/*)

metrics.threshold_basis: none: shown, never gates the verdict

metrics.name: Full-length reads
metrics.meaning: Reads (or read segments) flanked by both adapters in the expected orientation: adapter1 - cDNA - adapter2. Only these are analysed when full_length_only is on.

sources.field: table under 'Read assignment summary', column 'Full length', row 'count'

metrics.chart: funnel bar
metrics.threshold_basis: gated through sc_full_length_fraction

metrics.name: Full-length rate
metrics.meaning: Share of input reads that have the complete adapter pair. Low values point to a library-prep problem (fragmented cDNA, adapter dimers, chimeras).
metrics.chart: headline tile; hub column
metrics.threshold_basis: provisional default, set well below the values of good libraries; a laboratory adjusts it in its configuration

metrics.name: Adapter configuration
metrics.meaning: How many reads fall into each adapter layout: full length, single adapter1, single adapter2, double adapter1, double adapter2, no adapters, other.

sources.field: full_length, single_adapter1, single_adapter2, double_adapter1, double_adapter2, no_adapters, other
Bokeh figure with axis 'Primer configuration': columns `groups` and `<alias>` (percent of input reads)

metrics.chart: single horizontal stacked bar, full_length first; table on hover
metrics.threshold_basis: gated through sc_full_length_fraction

metrics.name: Plus-strand share
metrics.meaning: Share of stranded reads sequenced in the plus orientation. cDNA is read from either end at random, so this sits near one half; a value far from it means reads were lost on one side.

metrics.threshold_basis: provisional default, set well below the values of good libraries; a laboratory adjusts it in its configuration

metrics.name: Sequencing saturation (ONT workflow)
metrics.meaning: Share of gene-assigned reads that are repeat observations of a molecule already seen. Near 0: sequencing deeper finds new molecules with almost every read. Near 1: little left to find.

sources.field: Bokeh figure titled 'Sequencing saturation', first point; stored separately as `saturation.reported` because its denominator is all valid-barcode reads

metrics.formula: 1 - sc_unique_molecules / sc_gene_assigned_reads. The sum of the raw gene matrix IS the number of distinct (barcode, gene, UMI) among gene-assigned reads, so no de-duplication pass is needed.
metrics.chart: headline tile; point at the end of the saturation curve; hub column
metrics.threshold_basis: none: shown, never gates the verdict

metrics.name: Reads per molecule
metrics.meaning: How many molecules were seen once, twice, three times and so on. The whole saturation curve follows from this one histogram.

sources.field: rows per (corrected_barcode, corrected_umi, gene) among gene-assigned rows; needs the de-duplicating variant of the read pass

metrics.formula: h[c] = number of molecules seen c times, on bins.reads_per_molecule. Rows are grouped by chromosome and a key cannot recur on another chromosome, so the de-duplication runs one chromosome at a time with memory bounded by the largest chromosome.
metrics.chart: not drawn directly; feeds sc_saturation_curve
metrics.threshold_basis: none: shown, never gates the verdict

metrics.name: Saturation curve
metrics.meaning: Saturation as a function of sequencing depth, so the user can see whether more sequencing is worth it.
metrics.formula: for a depth fraction p: saturation(p) = 1 - sum_c h[c] * (1 - (1 - p)**c) / (p * sum_c c * h[c]). Exact expectation under random subsampling; computed in the viewer, nothing extra stored.

aggregate.key: derived in the viewer from saturation.reads_per_molecule

metrics.chart: line, x = reads, y = saturation, current depth marked; second line: unique molecules against reads
metrics.threshold_basis: none: shown, never gates the verdict

per-spot UMIs, genes, mito, reads; in_tissue, array_row, array_col
per-bin UMIs and genes; no tissue mask, no image

metrics.formula: Visium HD: rebin the 2 um grid by an integer factor (default 32, i.e. 64 um bins, 105 x 105). Channels: umis (sum, log1p scale), saturation (1 - umis/reads), tissue (fraction of squares under tissue), genes (mean genes per 8 um bin), mito (MT- UMIs / UMIs), image (mean grey level of the registered microscope image). Visium: one value per spot in (array_row, array_col) order, no rebinning. Every channel is quantised to uint8 (254 levels, 255 = no data), deflated and base64-encoded.
metrics.chart: canvas heat map with a channel switcher, tissue outline overlay and hover read-out; Visium draws hexagonally packed discs
metrics.threshold_basis: none: shown, never gates the verdict

checks.ok: The reads come from {n} flow cell run{s} of this library.
checks.warn_none: No flow cell run could be named for this analysis. State it with: flowcellar analysis DIR --run FLOWCELL.
checks.warn_unresolved: {missing} of the {n} flow cell runs this analysis came from {are} not in the library ({names}).

status_rules.roll_up: worst of all metric thresholds that apply to the assay, plus pipeline alarms; every triggered rule is listed as a reason
status_rules.scope: an analysis has its own status. It never changes the pass / warn / fail status of a flow cell run; the run row shows it as a separate badge.
status_rules.missing_data: a metric whose source is absent is 'not available', never a failure; numbers taken from an HTML report are marked
status_rules.overrides: every warn / fail value can be overridden per assay in the library's configuration; the catalogue values are defaults

size_budget.hub_index_row: scalars only, at most 1 kB per analysis; no map, no curve

excluded_on_purpose: UMAP coordinates (gene_expression_umap_*.tsv), clustering, differential expression, deconvolution, cell-type annotation: biological analysis, out of scope
Fusion transcript tables (ctat-LR-fusion): biological result, not QC
Read length and quality histograms of the workflow input: owned by the core's read-level tier, drawn from the linked run or its basecalled BAM
cloupe files, tissue_hires_image.png, geojson segmentations: large, and not needed for any metric
